# From Till

> Small offline tools. They run in your browser. Files stay on this computer.

For virtual assistants, nonprofit ops, and one-seat bookkeepers who cannot upload client CSVs. Plainrow Lite is free: stack two CSVs, remove duplicate rows. Kitchen is the paid offline HTML file. Polar delivers the zip. $19 one-time. Filter, columns, replace, dates, sort, recipes, and more than two files, plus join, stack, split, and clean. Monday jobs like catalog and warehouse SKU join. Nothing is uploaded.

## Tools

- [Plainrow Lite](https://fromtill.com/plainrow/app.html): free. Stack and dedupe in the browser.
- [Buy Kitchen](https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_WC72cncKI9qvJnIsKuSqE9gv2Aha7xU6HtiG50Pc2F9): $19 one-time. Filter, columns, replace, dates, sort, recipes, and more than two files, plus join, stack, split, and clean.
